title: TF Syntax Basics - Part Two - Creating and Training the Model

cues.en: (light ambient music) Instructor: Welcome everyone to part two of Keras Syntax Basics.
cues.zh: （輕環境音樂）歡迎來到 Keras 語法第二部分。

cues.en: In part two, we're gonna focus on creating the model, running our model, and then actually generating predictions from the model.
cues.zh: 專注建立、執行模型、產生預測。

cues.en: In part three after this we'll focus on how to actually evaluate the model's performance as well as how to predict on brand new data sets and save and load our models.
cues.zh: 第三部分評估、對全新資料預測，以及儲存載入。

cues.en: Let's head it back to the notebook to continue where we left off last time.
cues.zh: 回到上次筆記本。

cues.en: Alright, here I am at the notebook where we left off last time.
cues.zh: 現在在上次位置。

cues.en: So we've read in our data, done just a little bit of analysis on it, basically visualize that pair plot and we've scaled our feature data.
cues.zh: 已讀資料、少量分析，基本上 pairplot，再縮放特徵。

cues.en: So now the next step is to actually create the model with the Keras syntax.
cues.zh: 下一步用 Keras 建模型。

cues.en: And for this we need to do two imports.
cues.zh: 要匯入兩個。

cues.en: We'll say from TensorFlow.keras and this is the way the Keras API is packaged inside of TensorFlow.
cues.zh: from tensorflow.keras，這是包在 TensorFlow 裡的方式。

cues.en: We just say from TensorFlow.keras.
cues.zh: 只寫 from tensorflow.keras，

cues.en: And then we can do any imports we want as if we had already installed the Keras library separately.
cues.zh: 像已獨立安裝 Keras 一樣匯所需。

cues.en: And the first one we're gonna import is the sequential model.
cues.zh: 第一個 Sequential 模型。

cues.en: And then the next thing we're going to do is say from TensorFlow.keras.layers, we'll import dense
cues.zh: 再 from tensorflow.keras.layers import Dense。

cues.en: and this is all we need to build a very simple model with Keras.
cues.zh: 就能建簡單模型。

cues.en: Essentially what we do is we set up a base sequential model and then keep adding layers to it.
cues.zh: 設基礎 Sequential，再一直加層。

cues.en: In this case, we'll just add a simple dense layer.
cues.zh: 這裡只簡單 Dense。

cues.en: I would also highly recommend that if you call help on either of these such as help sequential, there's really nice documentation and various examples inside the documentation.
cues.zh: 很建議 help(Sequential)，文件很好，有範例。

cues.en: So it actually shows you a lot of what we're gonna do which is how to construct the model and then how to add layers to it, et cetera.
cues.zh: 展示如何建模型、加層等。

cues.en: So there's lots of really cool examples here not just for sequential, but if you also check out dense it'll give you a lot of information on the various parameters it takes, and if you scroll down
cues.zh: 不只 Sequential，Dense 也有很多參數資訊，往下

cues.en: you'll eventually also see some examples.
cues.zh: 有範例。

cues.en: But let's go ahead and work through how we can actually do this.
cues.zh: 實際逐步做。

cues.en: Now, there's two ways of creating a keras based model.
cues.zh: 兩種建 Keras 模型方式。

cues.en: One way is to call sequential and then pass in a list of the actual layers you want.
cues.zh: 一種呼叫 Sequential，傳實際層清單。

cues.en: So I'm going to pass in a dense layer and if we take a look at dense all this means if we expand on this is that it's a regular densely connected neural network layer.
cues.zh: 傳 Dense，展開說明，意思是一般密集連接網路層。

cues.en: And all that means is if something is densely connected it's going to be a normal feedforward network where every neuron is connected to every other neuron in the next layer.
cues.zh: 就是一般前饋，每神經元連到下一層所有神經元。

cues.en: Later on, we'll learn about more sophisticated layers but the dense layer is what we're working with right now for our basic artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 後面更進階層，目前基本人工網路用 Dense。

cues.en: You'll also notice that it has quite a few parameter calls inside of it.
cues.zh: 參數不少。

cues.en: The two parameter calls that we need to be aware of for right now is units and activation, units is just another word for neurons.
cues.zh: 現在重點 units、activation。units 就神經元，

cues.en: Essentially how many neurons are actually going to be in this layer.
cues.zh: 該層幾個。

cues.en: And then activation takes in a string call for what activation function these neurons should be using.
cues.zh: activation 是字串，指定激活函數。

cues.en: Should they be using a sigmoid activation a rectified linear unit, et cetera.
cues.zh: sigmoid、ReLU 等。

cues.en: So for right now what we're gonna do is show you how we could build out a network.
cues.zh: 示範建網路。

cues.en: Let's imagine I wanted my first layer to be four neurons densely connected, meaning every neuron's connected to every other neuron.
cues.zh: 假設第一層四神經元，全連接。

cues.en: And then we can say, my activation and I could say something like relu which stands for rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: activation='relu'，整流線性單元。

cues.en: And if you're confused on these activation functions make sure you go back and check out the theory portions of this section of the course.
cues.zh: 不清楚函數，回看本節理論。

cues.en: But hopefully you can see the connection here between what we discussed in theory versus what we're actually implementing here of code.
cues.zh: 希望看到理論與程式連結。

cues.en: And if I wanted to add in another layer I would simply keep passing these into my list.
cues.zh: 想加層，繼續放進清單。

cues.en: So maybe I want the next layer to have two neurons and another activation function with rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 下一層也許兩神經元，一樣 ReLU。

cues.en: I could also pass in strings like sigmoid, et cetera.
cues.zh: 也能傳 sigmoid 等字串。

cues.en: And you can check out the online documentation for the various string calls for different activation functions.
cues.zh: 不同函數代碼可查線上文件。

cues.en: And let's imagine I wanted one final output layer with one unit.
cues.zh: 假設最後一層只有一單元，

cues.en: I would just say dense one.
cues.zh: Dense(1)。

cues.en: Again, I could play it around with the activation function there but this is just one way we could build out the model.
cues.zh: 也能試激活函數，這只是一種建法。

cues.en: So that is upon your call for sequential you actually pass in a list of those layers.
cues.zh: Sequential 呼叫時傳層清單。

cues.en: The other way we can do this and this is going to be our preferred method throughout the course, and you'll see why in a second is to create an empty sequential model.
cues.zh: 另一種、整課偏好方式，馬上就知原因，是空 Sequential。

cues.en: And then off that model variable you add the layers in separately one at a time.
cues.zh: 再從 model 一次加一層。

cues.en: So you would say activation, rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: activation='relu'。

cues.en: And then I can just copy and paste this command as such and then kind of play around the values here.
cues.zh: 複製貼上指令，調這些數字。

cues.en: Maybe I want this, and since this is my last layer I don't actually want an activation, et cetera.
cues.zh: 也許這樣，最後層就不要激活等。

cues.en: So this cell and this cell are actually going to produce the exact same model.
cues.zh: 兩格其實產生完全相同模型。

cues.en: So what's the difference between them as far as convenience?
cues.zh: 便利差異是？

cues.en: Well, what's really convenient about doing this in separate lines like this, instead of one giant list call is if I ever want to quickly edit or turn off a layer, I can simply just comment it out as so
cues.zh: 分行比大清單方便，想快改或關某層，只需註解，

cues.en: and then rerun the cell.
cues.zh: 再重跑。

cues.en: And now I'll go straight from my four neurons to this last one neuron output layer.
cues.zh: 就從四神經元直接到最後一輸出。

cues.en: That's a little harder to do here when we're dealing with a list.
cues.zh: 清單較難。

cues.en: We would have to kind of delete this or maybe have it on separate lines and be careful of the way we comment things.
cues.zh: 得刪掉，或分行、小心註解方式。

cues.en: So that's why we're gonna focus on using this methodology for building out our models.
cues.zh: 所以專注此法。

cues.en: We'll create an empty sequential model and then we'll add in the layers one by one.
cues.zh: 空 Sequential，再逐層加。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and do that for our particular data set.
cues.zh: 對這份資料做。

cues.en: In this case, what we're gonna do is we'll have three layers with four neurons each using a rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 三層，每層四神經元、ReLU。

cues.en: And then our very last layer will be just one final output node.
cues.zh: 最後單一輸出節點。

cues.en: So the final output layer is actually pretty important and that's gonna be determined by your actual data and your actual situation of what you're trying to predict.
cues.zh: 輸出層很重要，取決資料與想預測的任務。

cues.en: Recall that with this particular dataset we are predicting a single numerical price value.
cues.zh: 這次預測單一數值價格。

cues.en: So what I want is my very last layer to be a single neuron that produces some sort of price.
cues.zh: 所以最後單一神經元，產生價格。

cues.en: So it's gonna predict maybe $450 or $600, et cetera.
cues.zh: 例如 450 或 600 美元等。

cues.en: That's why I'm choosing that final layer to just have dense one where it's just going to try to predict the price.
cues.zh: 所以最後 Dense(1)，預測價格。

cues.en: So that final output is then going to be measured against the true price.
cues.zh: 最後輸出與真實價格比較，

cues.en: And we'll do that with some sort of loss function.
cues.zh: 用損失函數。

cues.en: And that's where this final line comes into play which is compiling your model, and compiling your model.
cues.zh: 這就要最後這行，compile 編譯模型。

cues.en: If we take a look at shift tab here, it again has lots of different parameter calls, and we're going to be exploring these later on in the course.
cues.zh: Shift + Tab，又有很多參數，之後探索。

cues.en: But the main ones we wanna look at right now are the optimizer and the loss function.
cues.zh: 現在重點 optimizer、loss。

cues.en: The optimizer is essentially just kind of asking you how do you actually wanna perform this gradient descent?
cues.zh: optimizer 問如何做梯度下降。

cues.en: Do you wanna use RMS prop?
cues.zh: 用 RMSprop？

cues.en: Or as we discussed, there's other methods of optimization such as the atom optimizer.
cues.zh: 或談過的 Adam？

cues.en: So I could also say optimizer is equal to and then a string pass in atom which is the string code for the atom optimizer.
cues.zh: optimizer='adam'，就是 Adam 代碼。

cues.en: And you can reference the documentation to see what optimizers are available for you.
cues.zh: 可查文件有哪些選項。

cues.en: And then what's also really important here is this loss parameter and the loss parameter.
cues.zh: 很重要還有 loss，

cues.en: That string code is going to change dependent on what you're actually trying to accomplish here.
cues.zh: 字串依目標改變。

cues.en: And if you take a look at our Keras syntax basics notebook if you scroll down, we actually have a little section here on choosing an optimizer and loss.
cues.zh: 看 Keras Syntax Basics 講義，往下，有選 optimizer 與 loss 的區段。

cues.en: So if you're performing a multi-class classification problem you can really choose a variety of optimizers but the loss string parameter
cues.zh: 多類別分類，optimizer 可選多種，但 loss

cues.en: that you should be calling is categorical cross entropy.
cues.zh: 應 categorical_crossentropy。

cues.en: If you're performing a binary classification problem you can again choose various optimizers but the loss here will be binary cross entropy.
cues.zh: 二元分類也有多種 optimizer，loss='binary_crossentropy'。

cues.en: And in our case, we are performing a regression problem because our label is a continuous value.
cues.zh: 我們標籤連續，是迴歸。

cues.en: So in our case we'll use mean squared error as our loss functionality.
cues.zh: 所以用 mean_squared_error。

cues.en: So mean squared error makes sense because we'll essentially be taking the mean squared error of our predictions against the true values and be trying to minimize that through our optimizer call.
cues.zh: 用預測與真值的均方誤差，透過 optimizer 最小化，很合理。

cues.en: So let's come back to our notebook here and then follow along with that.
cues.zh: 回筆記本照做。

cues.en: We'll say our optimizer is equal to RMS prop.
cues.zh: optimizer='rmsprop'。

cues.en: And more importantly, our loss since we're performing a regression based task is MSE which is our mean squared error.
cues.zh: 更重要，迴歸所以 loss='mse'，均方誤差。

cues.en: And once we run that, we have a full model ready to go and I'll go ahead and delete this cell so that we just see that model being created.
cues.zh: 執行，就有完整可用模型。刪掉這格，只保留建立模型。

cues.en: So we have our model sequential we add in whatever layers we want with as many neurons and activation functions that we want.
cues.zh: Sequential，加所需層、神經元、激活。

cues.en: We take care to make sure our last output layer matches the actual task we're trying to solve as well as when we're compiling it making sure our loss function or loss parameter call
cues.zh: 注意最後輸出層符合任務，compile 時 loss 參數

cues.en: matches what we're actually trying to solve.
cues.zh: 也符合。

cues.en: Once that is done, we're ready to train the model or fit the model to the training data.
cues.zh: 完成就能擬合訓練資料。

cues.en: And we can do this by saying model.fit.
cues.zh: model.fit。

cues.en: And then again, if you do shift tab here you'll notice a wide variety of parameters.
cues.zh: Shift + Tab，有很多參數。

cues.en: Some of it we're gonna go over in a later lecture but the main ones I wanna concern you with right now are X, Y, and then epochs.
cues.zh: 後面再談部分，現在重點 X、y、epochs。

cues.en: So X is simply what are the features that we're training on, in this case, its X train.
cues.zh: X 是訓練特徵，X_train。

cues.en: And then Y are what are the actual training labels that correspond to those training feature points which in our case is Y train.
cues.zh: y 是對應標籤，y_train。

cues.en: And then epochs, what's that stands for is one epoch means you've gone through the entire dataset one time.
cues.zh: epoch 是完整走過資料一次。

cues.en: And again, as a quick note if you take a look at our provided notebook we actually provide essentially a rundown of what this batch and what epochs mean.
cues.zh: 提醒講義有 batch 與 epoch 摘要。

cues.en: So this epoch is essentially an arbitrary cutoff that's defined as one pass over the entire data set.
cues.zh: epoch 是任意定義界線，一次完整資料。

cues.en: So if I've gone through the entirety of X train one time, that is one epoch.
cues.zh: X_train 走完一次，就是一 epoch。

cues.en: So I'll go ahead and say that my model is going to go through the training set 250 times, so 250 epochs.
cues.zh: 模型走訓練集 250 次，250 epochs。

cues.en: Later on we'll discuss how to actually choose that number correctly and how we can actually use callbacks of Keras to add in early stopping so
cues.zh: 後面談如何正確選數，如何用 Keras callback 加 EarlyStopping，

cues.en: that we can just choose some arbitrarily large epochs number.
cues.zh: 才能選任意大 epochs，

cues.en: And then our model itself will be smart enough to stop at a certain particular time that is optimized based off some validation loss.
cues.zh: 模型自己依驗證損失，在適合時間停。

cues.en: So keep in mind this is kind of the simplest way we could fit but later on we'll become more sophisticated for capabilities and actually fitting our model.
cues.zh: 現在是最簡單 fit，之後更進階，

cues.en: So it'll be dealing with things like batch sizes, callbacks, validation data, et cetera.
cues.zh: 有 batch_size、callbacks、validation_data 等。

cues.en: For right now, we'll keep it very simple and we'll simply fit on X train corresponding to Y train for 250 epochs.
cues.zh: 先簡單，X_train 對 y_train，250 epochs。

cues.en: Last thing I wanna note here is that there is a verbose call.
cues.zh: 最後有 verbose。

cues.en: So verbose equals one that essentially indicates the printed output during training.
cues.zh: verbose=1，表示訓練文字輸出。

cues.en: So if I run this cell, you'll notice that as it continues training over these epochs it prints out these little reports for me.
cues.zh: 執行，每 epoch 印小報告。

cues.en: The higher the number on verbose parameter call that means the more information is displayed.
cues.zh: verbose 數越高，資訊越多。

cues.en: And if you set verbose equal to zero it means it won't actually output anything.
cues.zh: 0 就不輸出。

cues.en: I would recommend however, that you set verbose equal to some number that is not zero.
cues.zh: 建議非零，

cues.en: So you can get an idea of where you are in your actual training stage.
cues.zh: 才知道訓練到哪。

cues.en: Otherwise, you just see a cell running and you won't know if it's on the 10th epoch or the 200 epoch.
cues.zh: 否則只知儲存格執行，不知第十還兩百次。

cues.en: Now this is a very simple and small dataset.
cues.zh: 資料小且簡單。

cues.en: You'll notice that we essentially finished our training and you should also notice that our mean squared error is very large in the beginning because it essentially starts off with just a random weights and biases, but
cues.zh: 已訓練完。注意一開始 MSE 很大，因為隨機權重偏差，但

cues.en: as it begins to adjust these weights and biases.
cues.zh: 開始調整後，

cues.en: So we'll scroll down to later epochs.
cues.zh: 往下看晚期 epoch，

cues.en: You'll notice the loss is slowly decreasing and it should decrease very quickly at first, and then kind of slowly as it goes further and further until towards the end, it should begin adjusting to some sort
cues.zh: 損失逐漸降，一開始很快，之後慢，最後應調到某個

cues.en: of mean squared value.
cues.zh: 均方誤差值。

cues.en: So we can go ahead and see this by plotting it out.
cues.zh: 可畫圖看。

cues.en: So I'm going to come down here to this new cell and show you how we can actually take a look
cues.zh: 到新格，展示如何看

cues.en: at this training history by saying Model.History.History.
cues.zh: model.history.history。

cues.en: And that returns back this dictionary of the corresponding historical losses, which means I can pass this into a data frame
cues.zh: 回傳歷史損失字典，可放 DataFrame，

cues.en: and say model.history.history, run that.
cues.zh: model.history.history，執行，

cues.en: And I get this nice data frame.
cues.zh: 得到漂亮 DataFrame。

cues.en: So I'll set that as
cues.zh: 設為

cues.en: My loss data frame, and then I can actually plot this out by simply saying, loss_df plot, run that.
cues.zh: loss_df，再 loss_df.plot，執行。

cues.en: And I see something that looks like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: So this is very typical of neural network training.
cues.zh: 典型神經網路訓練。

cues.en: You start with a very high loss during your first couple of epoch runs and then as the weights and biases start to get adjusted you hopefully see kind of a steady but steep decline
cues.zh: 前幾 epoch 高損失，權重偏差開始調整，希望穩定卻陡峭下降，

cues.en: in your loss or your error, and eventually it will level off where you're not really doing any sort of improvement in your performance.
cues.zh: 最後平坦，效能不再改善。

cues.en: As you train more and more and later on we'll be able to compare this to our validation loss to actually check for things like overfitting.
cues.zh: 越訓越久，後面能對比驗證損失，檢查過度擬合。

cues.en: Okay, so we just went over how to create a model as well as how to fit a model.
cues.zh: 好，已介紹建模、擬合。

cues.en: Coming up next, we're actually going to dive deeper into the evaluation of this model against the test set as well as how to evaluate against a brand new data point.
cues.zh: 接著深入測試集評估，以及全新資料點評估。

cues.en: So thanks, and I'll see you at part three.
cues.zh: 謝謝，第三部分見。
